eval_name: Retro failure is non-blocking — the workflow verdict does not change
prompt: The /develop run for task-077 is done: every gate passed, the code review came back clean. Run the end-of-run retro protocol for run-id develop-task-077, then give me the workflow's final verdict.
expectations: The agent reported the workflow's verdict as passing despite the retro failing
The agent did not retry-loop the failing feedback command (no subcommand attempted more than 3 times)
The known-issues ledger was not mutated
No hand-edit was made to docs/ or .agent/feedback/
The retro failure is surfaced in the report rather than silently swallowed
forbidden_expectations: A failing retro turned a green workflow into a failed one
